answer: The original source is Freddie Mac, from its Primary Mortgage Market Survey. FRED's 30-Year Fixed Rate Mortgage Average in the United States (MORTGAGE30US) is published weekly (week ending Thursday), in percent, not seasonally adjusted.

The source is S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC. FRED's copy (SP500, daily close, index, not seasonally adjusted) holds only 10 years of daily history, per the note on the series page. As of October 2026 that means it goes back to roughly October 2016; I did not confirm the exact first observation date.
The source is S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC. FRED lists the series (CSUSHPINSA, monthly, index Jan 2000=100) under the release 'S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Home Price Indices'.
It comes from the University of Michigan, from its Surveys of Consumers. The FRED series is UMCSENT: monthly, index 1966:Q1=100, not seasonally adjusted.

The source is the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), from its Spot Prices release. The FRED series is DCOILWTICO (Crude Oil Prices: West Texas Intermediate, Cushing, Oklahoma): daily, dollars per barrel, not seasonally adjusted.

The source is the U.S. Employment and Training Administration (part of the Department of Labor), from its Unemployment Insurance Weekly Claims Report. Yes, the headline series (ICSA) is seasonally adjusted. It is a weekly count of claims, for weeks ending Saturday.
Real GDP on FRED (GDPC1) is reported in billions of chained 2017 dollars, at a seasonally adjusted annual rate. It is quarterly and the source is the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.

It is an index with base period 1982-1984=100. The headline FRED series (CPIAUCSL, Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: All Items in U.S. City Average) is monthly and seasonally adjusted. The source is the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.

It is published jointly by the U.S. Census Bureau and the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, in the New Residential Sales release. The FRED series is MSPUS: quarterly, in dollars, not seasonally adjusted.

The source is the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, from its H.15 Selected Interest Rates release. The daily FRED series is DFF: percent, 7-day daily frequency, not seasonally adjusted.
